fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/session (go test -trimpath ./internal/session/...): an autonomous session idle 21 minutes with the API-error detail is not Stalled while one with a plain idle detail is. cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/inbox-api-error.txtar (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/inbox-api-error): with a live run journal and a session record whose hook report is idle with the API-error detail, rhiza inbox --json has one item of kind api-error with the session, the run, the error text and the session message next step, and none of kind stalled at T+21m; the text inbox shows it; after a later working hook report the item is gone. Go tests in internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/api/ -run 'WebInbox|InboxNotice'): webInboxViews keeps an api-error item (webInboxKinds lists the new kind) with the change set's title and a detail naming the API error, and no session or run ID or handle in its title or detail; inboxNotice gives an api-error item its own line saying a session stopped on an API error, not the default gave-up line, with no handle or ID. A Go test in internal/tui/inboxapp (go test -trimpath ./internal/tui/inboxapp/...): an api-error item is a row, ActionFor gives it ActionShow, and Enter shows its kind and detail (the error text) and calls inbox.open on it. describe-golden.txtar is regenerated for the new kind (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden). Touches internal/session/status.go, internal/session/status_test.go, internal/api/run.go, internal/api/inbox.go, internal/api/daemon.go, internal/api/daemon_notice_test.go, internal/api/web_inbox.go, internal/api/web_inbox_test.go, internal/tui/inboxapp/inboxapp_test.go, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/inbox-api-error.txtar, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/describe-golden.txtar
fields.statement: A live run's step session whose hook report is idle with a detail starting 'stopped on an API error: ' (session.APIErrorDetail) is listed by rhiza inbox as an item of kind api-error naming the session, its run and the error, with `rhiza session message <session> <text>` as the next step, and the daemon's notice, the web inbox and the inbox app show it; such a session is never stalled, and its next hook report clears the item
